link.description: Post-process effects applied to any node via the `effects` prop. Blur, progressive blur, grayscale, pixelate, bloom, directional blur, motion blur, radial blur, chromatic aberration, bulge, magnify, displace, wave, twirl, kaleidoscope, trails, invert, scatter, posterize, threshold, dither, halftone, edges, sharpen, outline, vignette, grain, duotone, curves, color adjustment, RGB shift, scanlines, block displace, bit crush, ASCII, streak, god rays, oil paint, texture, vintage, and background blur. Plus a cookbook of named recipes to copy into your own project.
